title: Garhwali language - Wikipedia
text: Garhwali (गढ़वळि, IPA: [gɜɽʱʋɜɭiˑ], in native pronunciation) is an Indo-Aryan language of the Central Pahari subgroup. It is primarily spoken by over 2.4 million Garhwali people in the Garhwal division of the northern Indian state of Uttarakhand in the Indian Himalayas.

title: Listening to Garhwali Popular Music in and out of Place
text: Listening to popular music is a central means by which people construct their place in the world, both literally and figuratively.
